info.name: Ridgeline · Test Suite
info.description:
Automated tests for every Ridgeline API: **auth**, **functional** behavior, **business rules** and **negative cases**. 56 requests and 230 assertions, all order-independent: each test creates what it needs (its own boost, its own idempotency key), so folders can run alone.

## What's covered

| Folder | Requests | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| Auth | 24 | Each API accepts only its own key, and rejects a missing key, another API's key, and an unresolved Passport reference |
| Markets | 3 | Events and markets are listed, filtered by event, with valid odds |
| Player limits | 8 | Self-exclusion and cool-off block wagers **and** promotions; a daily limit blocks wagers only; bad input fails with the right code |
| Geo compliance | 3 | Casino availability by state |
| Wallet | 4 | Balances are integer cents; rewards credits are idempotent |
| Promotions | 6 | Boosts and claims work, claims are idempotent, unknown IDs return 404 |
| Bets | 8 | Payout math with and without a boost, the v2 `stake_minor` contract, and the platform safety nets |

Every request also checks response time (under 2s) and JSON content type, from collection-level tests. Each request's docs say why it exists and list its checks.


| Player | State | Status | Use it to test |
|---|---|---|---|
| `P-1001` | NJ | active | the happy path |
| `P-1002` | PA | active, $20.00 left of a $50.00 daily limit | `DAILY_WAGER_LIMIT` |
| `P-1003` | MI | **self-excluded** until 2027-06-30 | blocked wagers, **no promotions** |
| `P-1004` | NY | active | casino not available in state |
| `P-1005` | NJ | **cool-off** | blocked wagers, **no promotions** |


## Environments

| Environment | Use it for |
|---|---|
| **Ridgeline Sandbox · Mock** | Trying requests with no keys. The public mock answers every endpoint with its saved example response (no business logic) |
| **Ridgeline Sandbox · Passport** | The real API. Keys are Passport references (`{{vault:RIDGELINE_*_KEY}}`), resolved by the Passport proxy |
| **Ridgeline Sandbox · Local (no keys)** | `npm run local` on `http://localhost:4100`. Paste an owner key into the *current* value only |


## Run it

- **In Postman:** pick an environment (**Passport** or **Local**: these tests check real behavior, so the mock will fail them), then **Run collection** in the Collection Runner.
- **From a terminal:** `postman collection run public/postman/test-suite.postman_collection.json -e <environment>`
- **From the repo, against every collection:** `npm run test:postman`

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Each API accepts only its own bearer key. For every API: no key, another API's key, an unresolved Passport reference, and its own key. The unresolved-reference check builds the header in a pre-request script so the client sends the literal `{{vault:...}}` instead of resolving it.

**24 requests** in this folder. Each one checks its status and error code, plus response time and content type at the collection level.

request.description:
`GET /markets/v1/events`

**Checks**
- status 401
- rejected as unresolved reference (or unauthorized if the client resolved it)

exec: // Built in a script so the client sends the literal reference instead of resolving it.
pm.test('rejected as unresolved reference (or unauthorized if the client resolved it)', () => pm.expect(['unresolved_reference', 'unauthorized']).to.include(pm.response.json().error));

item.name: Markets
item.description:
Events and odds.

**API:** Markets API · **Owner:** Team Trading

Events and odds for the sportsbook. Read-only.

**3 requests** in this folder. Each one checks its status and error code, plus response time and content type at the collection level.

item.name: markets filter by event, odds are valid

request.description:
`GET /markets/v1/markets`

**Checks**
- status 200
- only the requested event
- every outcome has decimal odds > 1

exec: pm.test('every outcome has decimal odds > 1', () => m.flatMap(x => x.outcomes).forEach(o => pm.expect(o.decimal_odds).to.be.above(1)));

item.name: unknown event returns an empty list
Player limits (responsible gaming)
item.description:
The single source of truth for player protection.

**API:** Player Limits API · **Owner:** Team Responsible Gaming

Responsible-gaming eligibility: self-exclusion, cool-off and daily wager limits. The single source of truth for player protection. Never reimplement this logic in a caller. Self-excluded and cool-off players must not receive promotional offers (`may_receive_promotions: false`).

**8 requests** in this folder. Each one checks its status and error code, plus response time and content type at the collection level.

request.description:
**Why:** The happy path, so a regression that blocks everyone shows up here.

**Checks**
- status 200
- eligible
- may receive promotions

**Why:** The rule that matters most in this domain. A self-excluded player must never be shown or given a promotion, so `may_receive_promotions` has to be `false` whatever the amount.

**Checks**
- status 200
- not eligible
- reason SELF_EXCLUDED
- must not receive promotions

**Why:** Cool-off is temporary self-exclusion and gets the same treatment: no wagers, no promotions.

**Checks**
- status 200
- reason COOL_OFF
- must not receive promotions

item.name: P-1002 over daily limit → wager blocked, promotions still allowed

request.description:
**Why:** The two questions are different. A daily limit blocks the wager, but it is not a reason to withhold promotions. Callers that conflate them get this wrong.

**Checks**
- status 200
- reason DAILY_WAGER_LIMIT
- limit alone does not block promotions

exec: pm.test('limit alone does not block promotions', () => pm.expect(r.may_receive_promotions).to.be.true);

item.name: Geo compliance
item.description:
Product availability by state.

**API:** Geo Compliance API · **Owner:** Team Compliance

Which products a player may access in their state. Casino is available in NJ, PA and MI only (sandbox data).

**3 requests** in this folder. Each one checks its status and error code, plus response time and content type at the collection level.

request.description:
**Why:** Casino is legal in some states only. Offers and bets for casino must check location first.

**Checks**
- status 200
- not allowed
- reason given

item.name: Wallet
item.description:
Balances and idempotent rewards credits.

**API:** Wallet API · **Owner:** Team Payments

Player balances (cash, bonus, rewards) and rewards credits. All amounts are integer minor units (cents).

**4 requests** in this folder. Each one checks its status and error code, plus response time and content type at the collection level.

item.name: replaying the same idempotency key does not double-credit

request.description:
**Why:** Agents retry. A credit that is not idempotent pays twice when an agent retries after a timeout.

**Checks**
- status 201
- balance unchanged on replay

item.name: Promotions
item.description:
Boosts and claims (callers must check eligibility first).

**API:** Promotions API · **Owner:** Team Promotions

Boosts and claims. Promotions does not check responsible-gaming eligibility. Callers MUST call player-limits `POST /v1/eligibility/check` (and honor `may_receive_promotions`) and geo-compliance before offering or claiming a boost.

**6 requests** in this folder. Each one checks its status and error code, plus response time and content type at the collection level.

request.description:
**Why:** Retries must not create duplicate claims.

**Checks**
- status 201

item.name: claims list has exactly one claim for P-1001
Bets
item.description:
v2 contract (stake_minor) and platform safety nets.

**API:** Bets API · **Owner:** Team Bet Platform

Bet placement. v2 (2026-07): `stake` (decimal dollars) was removed and replaced by `stake_minor` (integer cents). Requests containing `stake` are rejected. Bets re-checks eligibility and location at placement as a safety net; it does not replace checking before an offer.

**8 requests** in this folder. Each one checks its status and error code, plus response time and content type at the collection level.

request.description:
`POST /bets/v1/bets`

**Checks**
- status 201
- accepted
- payout 1000 × 1.77 = 1770
- no rewards without a boost

**Why:** Pins the payout math, so a change to boost logic cannot silently change what players are paid.

**Checks**
- status 201
- boosted payout 1000 + 770 × 1.25 = 1963
- rewards = 10% of stake

**Why:** The v2 breaking change. Old clients (and models trained on the old docs) still send `stake`. The API must fail loudly and say what to send instead.

**Checks**
- status 400
- error code is unsupported_field
- points to stake_minor

**Why:** The safety net in bets: even if a caller skipped player-limits, the wager is refused.

**Checks**
- status 403
- error code is player_not_eligible
- reason SELF_EXCLUDED

**Why:** A boost only applies after a claim, so eligibility is always checked first.

**Checks**
- status 409
- error code is boost_not_claimed
